propositions: A failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) after successful issue creation triggers delete_issue, destroying a recoverable Jira issue to handle a labeling failure

The keyed-pending binding persists after rollback delete because record_pending_key stores the key before identity writes, stranding the local ticket permanently and causing repeated failed retro-attach attempts
The recover_pending keyed branch already exists to handle exactly the state left by a failed identity write and can deterministically retro-attach labels and properties without search
The delete_issue call is redundant with rebar's write-ahead recovery protocol and inverts cost by destroying successfully-created work rather than leaving it for repair
The Jira field rejection message is misleading and conflates three distinct causes: field not on Create/Edit screen, jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property, or malformed field value
